items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Well, right offhand, no, I sure don't.

ctx.x: Well, right offhand, no, I sure don't.
You say Tolls played bass? It was bass player. And you were playing trumpet?
I was just a kid then. Oh, just about six, seven, eight pieces. The regular bands like they had around here.
